scope: Uniform-query, full-rank three-summand relation collection with a signed P-192 base
statement: For a signed base of B points in a prime-order group of order r, a uniform independent query has exactly binomial(B+2,3)/r expected unordered three-term decompositions. With B=2^45 and U=B/2 effective unknown base logs on P-192, U rows require at least 2^103.585 queries in expectation, before solver cost; this is conditional on full-rank collection and excludes structured-log or early target-span routes.
